deploy.explain.trunkMode: Configures the port as a trunk carrying multiple VLANs.

deploy.explain.portSecurity: Enables port security and MAC control.
deploy.explain.dhcpSnooping: Enables or adjusts DHCP Snooping to protect against rogue DHCP servers.
deploy.explain.dai: Enables or adjusts Dynamic ARP Inspection.
deploy.explain.ipSourceGuard: Enables IP Source Guard on the port.
deploy.explain.exit: Returns to the previous configuration mode.
deploy.explain.dot1q: Tags the subinterface with the specified VLAN for RoaS.
deploy.explain.ipAddress: Assigns an IP address and mask to the interface.
deploy.explain.defaultRoute: Creates the default route toward the next hop.
deploy.explain.nat: Configures NAT overload for Internet access.
deploy.explain.acl: Defines an ACL or rule used by NAT/filtering.
